locked.title: Maximum attempts reached
locked.description: You have already completed {{courseTitle}} the maximum number of {{maxTries}} {{times}} allowed. Contact your administrator if you believe this is a mistake.

readOnly.title: Course Already Completed
readOnly.description: You have already earned a certificate for {{courseTitle}}. You cannot finish the course again to earn more SP or additional certificates.

courseUnavailable.notPublishedDescription: Nothing has been published for this course. Once it is, this page will show it.
courseUnavailable.notAvailableDescription: The link may have been switched off, or the course removed.
courseUnavailable.loadFailedDescription: Something went wrong on the way here. Check your connection and try again.

retryConfirm.title: Start another attempt?
retryConfirm.description: Your previous answers for {{courseTitle}} will be cleared and your progress starts over. Your earned certificate stays.

versionUpdateConfirm.title: This course has been updated
versionUpdateConfirm.description: A newer version of {{courseTitle}} is available. Continuing clears your current progress and starts you on the new version.
